about: The food types Spisekammer knows (S-009), each one FoodKeeper record (USDA FSIS, CC0, v128). Keeping times are read from the record by scripts/build-food-types.ts; only names, the category and the words that point to the type are ours. Produce names come from stead (checked there); the rest are drafts until checked (docs/FOOD_TYPES_REVIEW.md). Keys: a word matches a word of the product name that starts with it; several words match in any order; '=' means the whole word only.
